organization.name: SANCTUARY LV
organization.tagline: A New Kind of Sanctuary for Las Vegas
organization.mission: Sanctuary LV exists to create environments where people can encounter Jesus, experience authentic community, discover purpose, develop their gifts, and become equipped to impact the city.
organization.summary: Sanctuary LV is developing a new kind of gathering space for Las Vegas at the intersection of faith, creativity, culture, community, hospitality, and live experiences.
organization.summaryDetail: The vision goes beyond a traditional Sunday-use church facility: a flexible environment that serves people, supports creative expression, and brings the community together throughout the week.

ctas.closing: Let's Build Something Meaningful for Las Vegas.
ctas.closingDetail: Sanctuary LV is currently developing its location and real-estate strategy and welcomes conversations with City leaders, developers, property owners, economic-development partners, and community stakeholders who see alignment with the vision.

opportunity.title: Why Las Vegas
opportunity.intro: Las Vegas is one of America's most distinctive cultural, hospitality, entertainment, and creative markets. Sanctuary LV sees an opportunity to serve people who may not naturally connect with conventional church environments.
opportunity.position: Not apart from the city's culture. A positive contribution to it.
audiences: People disconnected from traditional church environments

facility.name: Main Experience Room
facility.description: A flexible worship, concert, teaching, conference, and live-event environment. Approximately 300–800 people initially, depending on the property and development phase, with future expansion preferred.

facility.name: Arrival / Lobby
facility.description: An open, hospitality-driven arrival environment for guest reception, community interaction, check-in, merchandise, information, and event activation.

facility.name: Central Stage / Production
facility.description: Professional infrastructure for live music, worship, speaking, video production, livestreaming, concerts, and creative performances.

facility.name: Hospitality / Mocktail Bar
facility.description: A premium non-alcoholic hospitality environment, serving as a social gathering area before and after experiences.

facility.name: Prayer & Care Areas
facility.description: Private or semi-private environments for prayer, pastoral care, counseling, ministry, and reflection.

facility.name: Creative / Production Areas
facility.description: Potential spaces for podcasting, content production, music, rehearsals, creator collaboration, and media production.

facility.name: Leadership / Classrooms
facility.description: Flexible rooms for discipleship, leadership development, ministry training, workshops, meetings, and small groups.

facility.name: Administrative Areas
facility.description: Operational workspace for Sanctuary leadership and staff.

strategies.name: Adaptive Reuse
strategies.description: Former nightclub, live music venue, theater, entertainment property, or similar venue.

strategies.name: Adaptive Reuse
strategies.description: Commercial, retail, warehouse, flex, or mixed-use property capable of conversion.

strategies.name: Ground-Up
strategies.description: Land suitable for a purpose-built Sanctuary campus.

strategies.name: Public / Private
strategies.description: Potential participation in a larger economic or community-development initiative.

locations.name: Southwest Las Vegas
locations.detail: Evaluate accessibility, adaptable commercial inventory, parking, and room to grow.

locations.name: Enterprise
locations.detail: Explore opportunities in the southwest valley; Enterprise is administered by Clark County.

locations.name: Arts District / Downtown-adjacent
locations.detail: Evaluate cultural alignment, adaptive reuse, and neighborhood activation potential.

locationNote: Open to additional areas identified by the City where redevelopment, community activation, entertainment, cultural programming, or economic-development objectives align with the project.
jurisdictionNote: Geographic priorities span the Las Vegas Valley, not exclusively City limits. Enterprise is an unincorporated town administered by Clark County. Confirm jurisdiction and the appropriate reviewing authority for every property.

requirements.name: Building
requirements.detail: Approximate initial target. Properties outside this range may be considered depending on layout and expansion potential.

requirements.name: Assembly capacity
requirements.detail: Approximate initial objective; future scalability preferred. Actual occupancy requires property-specific review.

requirements.name: Parking
requirements.detail: On-site parking or a credible shared-parking strategy.

requirements.name: Access
requirements.detail: Easy access from major transportation corridors.

requirements.name: Visibility
requirements.detail: Destination access may offset lower visibility.

requirements.name: Ceiling height
requirements.detail: Strongly preferred for production, lighting, staging, and event flexibility.

requirements.name: Zoning & entitlements
requirements.detail: Support or a realistic entitlement pathway for assembly, religious use, live events, community and educational programming, office/administrative use, and compatible accessory uses. No legal zoning determination is implied.

impact.name: Community Gathering
impact.description: An accessible environment for connection, relationships, and community formation.

impact.name: Youth & Young Adult Engagement
impact.description: Programming designed to engage emerging generations.

impact.name: Creative Economy
impact.description: Opportunities for musicians, filmmakers, creators, production professionals, and artists.

impact.name: Workforce & Leadership Development
impact.description: Training, leadership development, volunteer experience, and professional opportunities.

impact.name: Veteran Engagement
impact.description: Intentional opportunities to serve veterans and military-connected individuals.

impact.name: Hospitality Workforce
impact.description: Community and programming accessible to people working nontraditional schedules in hospitality and entertainment.

impact.name: Events & Cultural Programming
impact.description: Additional cultural, educational, music, and community programming.

impact.name: Neighborhood Activation
impact.description: Potential contribution to redevelopment or activation of underutilized commercial or entertainment properties.

stages.title: Activate
stages.description: Pop-up gatherings, partner venues, Sanctuary Nights, community events, and temporary activations.
stages.milestone: Validate audience, programming, operational requirements, and geographic demand.

stages.title: Establish
stages.description: Secure an initial permanent or long-term facility through adaptive reuse, acquisition, lease, development partnership, or another viable structure.
stages.milestone: Advance when a viable property, operating structure, and organizational readiness align.

stages.title: Expand
stages.description: Develop the long-term Sanctuary LV campus and broader ecosystem as organizational capacity and community demand grow.
stages.milestone: Scale in response to demonstrated demand and organizational capacity, not a guaranteed construction date.

city.name: Site Identification
city.description: Identify districts, redevelopment opportunities, existing buildings, underutilized properties, or development areas that may align with the project.

city.name: Development Navigation
city.description: Understand the appropriate City departments and processes for evaluating potential properties.

city.name: Zoning & Entitlements
city.description: Early guidance on zoning, assembly, entertainment, parking, occupancy, and entitlements. Final determinations depend on specific properties and formal review by the appropriate authority.

city.name: Economic Development Programs
city.description: Identify potentially applicable development, redevelopment, workforce, business, cultural, or economic-development programs. No eligibility for any specific incentive is claimed.

city.name: Strategic Introductions
city.description: Appropriate connections to property owners, developers, brokers, redevelopment stakeholders, community organizations, and economic-development partners.

city.name: Long-Term Partnership
city.description: Establish an ongoing dialogue with relevant City stakeholders as the project progresses. No existing City partnership or endorsement is implied.
